description.value: Sahara Courtyard Inn is a motel in Osoyoos, BC, situated near Haynes Point Provincial Park and Rattlesnake Canyon. The property offers a seasonal outdoor pool, BBQ facilities, a game room, and a children's playground, catering to families and leisure travellers in BC's southern Okanagan. Select rooms include kitchenette facilities, and free on-site parking is available.

Amenity data (laundry, vending machine, free Wi-Fi, pool, BBQ, etc.) comes from this non-affiliated source and must be treated as lower-confidence than a direct property site; however, it corroborates the address from OSM. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, pump, e-bike charging, bike wash) are mentioned anywhere in either OSM tags or the third-party site content.

No confirmed official website or direct property contact page was available; the motel's own site (if it exists) may differ in amenities, contact details, or policies.
